name: jade-pixi
description: PIXIJS renderer scene framework — headless 2D scene renderer (node-canvas) implementing the §7 scene JSON: parallax layers, particles, cutout characters with bob/run actions, camera push_in/pan. (pixi.js-legacy v7 requires a DOM even with node-canvas — verified 2026-08-30, 'document is not defined' — so the scene framework runs directly on node-canvas with the same JSON contract. See design doc §7.)
